description: MyAgents optimizations - persistence fixes, admin controls, chat UI improvements, and quality-of-life enhancements

userStories.title: Persist agent display names and timeout settings across CLI restarts
userStories.description: As a user, I want my agent display names and timeout settings to persist when I restart the CLI, so I don't have to reconfigure them each time.
acceptanceCriteria: Agent display names survive CLI restart and reconnection
Agent timeout settings survive CLI restart and reconnection
Settings are stored in a persistent location (DB or config file)
On CLI connect, previously saved display names and timeout settings are restored
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Investigate where display names and timeout settings are currently stored (likely only in-memory on the WebSocket connection or server state). Move to database or persistent config.

userStories.title: Admin page with signup deactivation toggle
userStories.description: As an admin, I want a dedicated admin page where I can deactivate new user signups so I can control who can access the platform.
acceptanceCriteria: New admin page route accessible only to admin users
Toggle to enable/disable new user signups
When signups are disabled, the signup form shows a message explaining signups are closed
Setting persists in the database
Check Better-Auth for admin role and signup control patterns
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Use kctx to research Better-Auth admin capabilities and signup control. May need a system settings table in the database.

userStories.title: Invitation email system for admins
userStories.description: As an admin, I want to send invitation emails to new users so I can control who joins the platform when signups are disabled.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin page has an 'Invite User' form with email input
Sends invitation email via SMTP using React Email for templating
Invitation contains a unique signup link with a token
Invited users can sign up even when general signups are disabled
Invitation tokens expire after a configurable period (default 7 days)
Admin can see list of pending invitations and revoke them
Check Better-Auth for invitation flow patterns
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Use kctx to research Better-Auth invitation patterns and React Email + SMTP setup. Depends on OPT-002 for admin page.

userStories.title: Hide 'Resumed session' lines from chat web UI
userStories.description: As a user, I want the chat UI to filter out CLI-internal metadata lines like 'Resumed session...' so I only see actual conversation content.
acceptanceCriteria: Messages starting with '↻ Resumed session' are filtered out or hidden in the web chat UI
Other similar CLI metadata lines (e.g., session restoration notices) are also filtered
The filtering happens on the display side only — raw messages are preserved in the database
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: This is a display-layer filter. Look at where messages are rendered in the conversation view and add a filter/transform step.

userStories.title: Markdown rendering setting for agent chat messages
userStories.description: As a user, I want agent chat messages to be rendered as markdown by default, with an option to toggle this per agent.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a 'Render as Markdown' setting per agent (default: true)
When enabled, agent messages are rendered as formatted markdown (headings, bold, code blocks, lists, etc.)
When disabled, agent messages are shown as plain text
Use a well-maintained React markdown renderer library
Setting persists in the database on the Agent model
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Research good React markdown renderers (react-markdown, marked, etc.). Add renderMarkdown boolean field to Agent model.

userStories.title: Delete conversations from desktop app
userStories.description: As a user, I want to be able to delete conversations from the desktop/web app so I can clean up old or unwanted chats.
acceptanceCriteria: Delete button/action is accessible on conversation list items and within conversation view
Uses AlertDialog with type-to-confirm for destructive action (per overlay conventions)
Deletion removes the conversation and all its messages
Works on both desktop and PWA
After deletion, user is redirected to the agent's conversation list
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Check if conversation.delete oRPC route already exists. If so, this is purely a UI task. Follow overlay conventions from AGENTS.md (AlertDialog with type-to-confirm for delete).

userStories.title: Queue messages during CLI disconnection and retry on reconnect
userStories.description: As a user, I want messages sent while the CLI is briefly disconnected to be queued and delivered when the connection is restored, rather than silently failing.
acceptanceCriteria: When a message is sent to an agent whose CLI node is disconnected, the message is stored in an in-memory queue on the server
When the CLI reconnects, queued messages are delivered in order
Messages in the queue have a TTL (e.g., 5 minutes) — expired messages are discarded with an error sent to the user
User sees a 'pending delivery' indicator for queued messages
If the queue TTL expires, user is notified that the message could not be delivered
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Server-side in-memory queue. Consider edge cases: what if the CLI reconnects as a different node? What if multiple messages queue up?

userStories.title: Fix navbar hiding on input focus — desktop only bug
userStories.description: As a desktop user, I don't want the navbar to hide when I focus a text input. This behavior should only activate on mobile devices.
acceptanceCriteria: On mobile viewports, the navbar continues to hide when a text input is focused (existing behavior preserved)
On desktop viewports (md breakpoint and above), the navbar remains visible when text inputs are focused
The breakpoint matches the existing responsive design system (md: 768px)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Look for the navbar hide-on-focus logic — likely uses a resize/focus listener or CSS. Add a viewport width check so it only triggers on mobile.

userStories.title: Reset password flow when email is configured
userStories.description: As a user, I want to be able to reset my password via email when the system has email (SMTP) configured.
acceptanceCriteria: When email environment variables are set, a 'Forgot password?' link appears on the login page
Clicking it shows a form to enter email address
Submitting sends a password reset email with a secure, time-limited token
The reset link leads to a page where the user can set a new password
Token expires after 1 hour
When email is NOT configured, the 'Forgot password?' link is hidden
Check Better-Auth for built-in password reset support
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Use kctx to research Better-Auth password reset flow. This likely requires email sending infrastructure from OPT-003 (React Email + SMTP). Can be implemented independently if email utils are set up first.
